title: cyclosorus costatus
intro: Cyclosorus costatus, commonly known as the Rattlesnake Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus costatus include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic, making it a popular remedy for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
